postNotes: Copy mode registers middleware.IAMSession() and, when the project serves gRPC, interceptor.IAMSession() without arguments; a model declaring GRPC() later needs the copy run again for the interceptor.
Set IAM_SESSION_EXPIRATION, for example 30m or 24h, to override the default session lifetime without editing copied code.
Set IAM_SESSION_USER_STATE_TTL, for example 30s or 1m, to tune the user-state cache TTL without editing copied code.
If project-owned initialization calls SetSessionExpiration(...), that explicit value overrides IAM_SESSION_EXPIRATION.
Set IAM_ROOT_PASSWORD to have SeedRoot write the root account at the first start; other baseline accounts go through the copied CreateAccount in a router.OnRoutesReady hook of the project's.
If copied login accepts tenant_id, non-root users need authz RBAC role binding in that tenant; otherwise tenant selection is rejected.
Non-root tenant admin IAM APIs require module/authz RBAC tenant role assignments; without authz they remain root-only through the built-in RBAC fallback.
